description: Speed the two-level projector path (_eigh_twolevel) that handles the clustered/A2-approx-I shapes 9 (clustered512 ~44ms) and 11-class. Profile _eigh_twolevel and move its FP32-SIMT GEMMs (the projector applications P+/-@M and the reduced-block solves) onto tensor cores where returned-factor-safe: FP32-accurate 3xTF32 for the projector GEMMs, and check whether the reduced block solve can use the batched cluster/mega path instead of per-matrix cuSOLVER. Pure torch, per-matrix residual-gated. Targets shape 9 (and any two-level-routed matrices in the mixed batches).

t1: _eigh_twolevel per-block NS GEMMs FP32-SIMT->3xTF32. REGRESSION shape9 44117->47498us (+7.7%), geomean 29802->29943. NS blocks ~256 wide: 3xTF32 split overhead outweighs TC rate on medium GEMMs. 39/39 valid, stream absent, 0 new fallback.

t2: projector A@X GEMMs FP64->3xTF32(FP32). STRONG REGRESSION shape9 44117->77480us (+76%), shape6 +23%, geomean 29802->31577. 39/39 valid but mass cuSOLVER fallback: 3xTF32 ~6e-6 projection leakage corrupts ill-conditioned random projection past gate. Projector needs FP64. stream absent.

WINNING STACK on _eigh_twolevel (all pure-torch, reusing existing helpers): (a) per-matrix 2-step NS RESCUE -- NS only the handful of matrices whose single-pass-CQR orth is near/over the gate (trigger 60*n*eps), not all 640, so the ~99.7% clean majority skips NS entirely; replaced the parent's unconditional per-block NS (~16.5% FP32-SIMT on shape 9); (b) orth-gate Gram FP32-SIMT->3xTF32 (_gram_3xtf32_sym, same as sign-DC gate) -- moves the last FP32-SIMT simt_sgemm (7.5%) to tensor cores; (c) CQR back-solve as kp*kp triangular inverse + FP64 GEMM; (d) DETERMINISTIC seeded FP64 G (gseed 5555, swept) -- removes the parent's stochastic bad-draw fallback; (e) all-2-level fast path -- skip the identity af[idx] gather / Qc scatter / unused alloc when is2.all() (shape 9); (f) assemble Q pre-sorted [Qm|Qp] + FP32 L directly -- drop FP64 L, torch.sort, n*n gather, no-op cast; (g) fuse projector 0.5*(A@X+/-X) via baddbmm on the FP64 GEMM.

MEASURED DEAD-ENDS (brief's precision suggestions -- all mass-fall-back to cuSOLVER because the near-degenerate clustered spectrum, ~1e-5 within-cluster jitter, needs FP64 ACCUMULATION which no pure-torch tensor-core path provides): t2 projector 3xTF32 (+76%), t3 projector true-FP32-SIMT (+69%), t4 single projection (+300%), t5 route 2-level through TF32 sign-DC (+466%), t8 NS in plain 1-pass TF32 (2-seed fallback), t19 mixed-precision projector 3xTF32-then-FP64 (+6%, sound but 3xTF32 overhead+casts exceed the d884->TF32 saving on the medium GEMM). Brief suggestion #2 (route reduced-block solve to the batched cluster megakernel) does not apply: _eigh_twolevel has NO per-matrix cuSOLVER loop -- its reduced-block solve is already a batched FP64 CholeskyQR, and the blocks (kp~341, n-kp~171) are BELOW _MEGA_CLUST_KMIN=449.
